decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly deploy aggressive creatures like Basking Rootwalla, Vengevine, and Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis by utilizing cards that allow for graveyard recursion such as Bloodghast and Stitcher's Supplier. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced strategy while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Force of Vigor and Grief. The use of cards like Once Upon a Time and Hollow One helps to maintain card advantage and consistency in drawing threats. Additionally, the deck includes powerful mana acceleration with Black Lotus and the Moxen to quickly deploy threats.

The deck focuses on using Doomsday to set up a winning combo involving Thassa's Oracle and various spells to manipulate the top of the library. It includes powerful card selection and manipulation spells like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Preordain, as well as disruption spells like Force of Will and Duress to protect the combo. The deck also includes fast mana acceleration with cards like Dark Ritual and Moxen to quickly cast key spells. The goal is to efficiently assemble the combo pieces and win the game in a single turn.

The deck is focused on controlling the game through counterspells, card draw, and disruptive cards like Narset, Parter of Veils, and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its win condition with cards like Time Vault and Tinker. The deck also has a strong mana base with powerful mana rocks like Black Lotus and Moxen, enabling it to cast its spells quickly and efficiently. Overall, the key strategy is to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through careful resource management and efficient card selection.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Paradoxical Outcome and artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxen to generate a large amount of mana, draw cards, and replay powerful spells. It aims to create a loop where it can continuously bounce and replay its artifacts to draw cards, generate mana, and eventually win the game through a combo or overwhelming card advantage. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade to protect its game plan and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on assembling the Underworld Breach combo to generate a loop that allows the player to cast spells from their graveyard. Using cards like Laelia, the Blade Reforged and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to generate mana and card advantage, the deck aims to quickly find and deploy the combo pieces. The deck also includes disruptive elements like counterspells and removal to protect the combo. Overall, the key strategy is to efficiently and effectively recycle spells from the graveyard to overwhelm the opponent and win the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful control cards, card draw, and mana acceleration to outmaneuver and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By using a combination of counterspells, card selection, and powerful artifacts like Time Vault and Bolas's Citadel, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and generate overwhelming advantage. The inclusion of cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Hullbreacher further disrupt the opponent's strategies while Urza, Lord High Artificer and Monastery Mentor provide additional win conditions. The deck excels at maintaining control of the board and resources while setting up for a decisive victory.

The deck focuses on ramping up quickly to play powerful artifact creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategies with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Trinisphere. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and efficient mana usage, taking advantage of cards like Mishra's Workshop and Urza's Saga to quickly establish board presence. The deck also includes cards like Nettlecyst and Walking Ballista to potentially close out games quickly, while also utilizing cards like Phyrexian Revoker and Chalice of the Void for disruption and control.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful spells and mana acceleration. By using cards like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to counter opponent's spells, along with disruptive cards like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and Pithing Needle, the deck aims to stall the opponent and set up for a game-winning play with cards like Bolas's Citadel or Time Vault combo. The deck also utilizes powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time to ensure it can find the right answers at the right time.
